verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that 1Password stores and displays standard one-time passwords (docs-20, docs-19). Nothing in the pack mentions Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, or custom periods and digit lengths. Basic TOTP support is a related capability, not the non-standard token support this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
